event.description: Retain head-specific symmetric geometry while sharing query-key skew
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 6 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020, which removed attention output projections and qualified at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0099, whose shared-symmetric/head-specific-skew decomposition scored 0.05% at 1,585 parameters. Hypothesis: head identity is carried by undirected similarity geometry rather than by the directed component. This major representational change tests the exact complement of attempt-0099: two head-specific 136-scalar symmetric forms, one shared 120-scalar skew form, and the 256-scalar value map, yielding 1,601 parameters by checkpoint decomposition. It is more informative than another generic low-rank alternative because attempts 0097-0099 separately establish that symmetry-only, full head-sharing, and head-specific skew are insufficient; this candidate uniquely preserves head-specific symmetric structure while restoring directionality. Generic causal softmax self-attention and autoregressive decoding remain intact.
